description:
Your Role 

 Wind River, an Aptiv Company, is seeking a Member of Technical Staff – Systems to provide technical leadership and systems expertise for complex embedded Linux engineering projects. In this senior individual contributor role, you will serve as a technical lead, architect, and mentor, shaping system architecture and driving technical excellence across mission-critical software solutions.

 You will work across Linux kernel development, user-space applications, device drivers, build systems, and compiler toolchains. This is an opportunity to solve complex technical challenges, influence engineering standards, and collaborate with globally distributed teams building secure, reliable, and high-quality embedded systems.
 


 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of major embedded Linux features, system components, and technical solutions.
 Develop and maintain embedded Linux systems software, including user-space applications, kernel components, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, and toolchains.
 Implement new functionality and enhancements while delivering high-quality, maintainable C/C++ code.
 Investigate, debug, and resolve complex system-level, software, performance, and integration issues.
 Provide technical direction through architecture decisions, design and code reviews, mentoring, and engineering best practices.
 Collaborate with Product, Quality Assurance, Support, and distributed engineering teams across the United States, Romania, and India.
 Contribute to technical planning, estimation, documentation, knowledge sharing, software security, and CVE management.
 


 Your Background 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 8+ years of experience with embedded Linux or systems programming.
 Expert-level proficiency in C/C++, with deep knowledge of Linux kernel architecture, kernel development, user-space applications, device drivers, and hardware abstraction.
 Experience with system architecture, embedded systems development, compiler toolchains, and build systems such as Yocto, Buildroot, or similar.
 Demonstrated experience leading technical projects, reviewing architecture and code, mentoring engineers, and solving complex technical problems.
 Experience with Git, code review processes, software development lifecycle practices, and Agile methodologies. Experience with open-source contributions, real-time systems, RTOS, hardware bring-up, BSP development, automotive, aerospace, industrial, or embedded security environments is preferred.
 Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without requiring visa sponsorship or transfer now or at any time in the future. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Candidates must also be local residents of the Greater Austin, Texas area.
 


 Why Join Aptiv 
 You grow at Aptiv. Aptiv’s winning culture is global by design. We bring together diverse perspectives, cultures, and business contexts to solve our customers’ toughest challenges. In this environment, every individual can grow, lead, and make an impact, regardless of background, because inclusion fuels how we innovate and win.
 You make an impact at Aptiv. One of the strengths of humanity is our drive to progress, to improve, to achieve more tomorrow than we did yesterday. People need solutions they can trust when it matters most. At Aptiv, you are building those solutions every day.
 You have support at Aptiv. We ensure you have the resources and support you need to take care of your family, your physical health, and your mental health with a competitive benefits package.
 


 Your Benefits at Aptiv 
 Health, dental, vision, and life insurance.
 Flexible time off supporting work-life balance.
 Eligibility to enroll in a 401(k) plan.
 12 paid holidays.
 Employee assistance and well-being resources.
 Learning and professional development opportunities.
 


 Meet the Next-Generation Aptiv 

 At Aptiv, we deliver innovative solutions that people trust when it matters most. 

 Progress is never static. It is about reaching further, exploring new possibilities, and enabling mobility. Aptiv empowers customers to create solutions people rely on, advancing safety and autonomy in Automotive and Commercial Vehicles, enabling mission-critical performance in Aerospace & Defense, and powering intelligent systems across Energy, Enterprise, and Telecommunications. We also drive precision and efficiency in Industrials & Robotics and support life-critical innovation in Medical technologies.

 Guided by our winning culture and values to Think & Act Like Owners, as One Team, and Play to Win, we turn commitment into results and achieve more together.

 Join Us to Deliver Innovative Solutions That People Trust! 

 #LI-AL3

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.
